title: Exotic Spicy Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Greek dish featuring lamb, Chinese five spice powder, and a hint of spice, perfect for a date night, served on a hot stone plate. This low-carb-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, Chinese five spice powder, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a hot stone plate and brush with lemon juice.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
